WHY_ME.TITLE: Why me
WHY_ME.TEXT: Code is more than syntax to me — it's the art of turning complex problems into clear, working solutions. I'm driven by analytical thinking paired with the creativity to find unconventional paths through tricky challenges. I bring persistence when a bug refuses to reveal itself, and in a team I value open communication just as much as collaborating on the best possible solution.

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skills
SKILLS.LEARNING_TEXT: I'm currently expanding my skillset toward backend development and infrastructure.

COLLEAGUES.TITLE: Need a teamplayer?
COLLEAGUES.SUBTITLE: Here's what my colleagues say about me

PAUL.QUOTE: Felix is a valuable team player who enriches every team by combining technical competence, a positive attitude and strong social skills. His ability to give others confidence while staying open to different perspectives makes him an ideal colleague.

JUERGEN.QUOTE: Felix did great work as a true team player. With his backend skills he was indispensable on the project. He was always approachable for his team members. I would gladly work with him again.

EMIL.QUOTE: Felix stands out through a high degree of personal responsibility. He has strong communication skills that let him address issues within the team objectively and with a solution-oriented mindset. He shows genuine interest in continuously improving processes through detailed analysis and constructive dialogue.
